name: Withdrawal 0xc3490263 both approves and transfers the amount to the caller
summary: The unverified contract's withdrawal function 0xc3490263 approves the caller for the withdrawn USDT and also transfers it, leaving an allowance the caller can spend again. The attacker deposited 5,955.47 flash-loaned USDT with deposit(uint256,uint256), withdrew it, then used the leftover allowance to transferFrom the contract's other 5,955.47 USDT, its whole balance.
notes: Behaviour is from the trace; the contract is unverified. Of its 1,540 USDT transfers since deployment, the anchor is the only transaction paying out more USDT than it received or paying the same amount twice to one recipient, and the contract has had no USDT since.
